The '''Elegant Fireplace''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

One Elegant Fireplace is obtained when the [[Farmhouse|Bedroom]] is redecorated by [[Penny]] in her [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event, choosing Strawberry Home.

[[Furniture#Fireplaces|Fireplaces]] cannot be placed outside. Once placed, right-clicking on it will turn the fire on or off.
